rows.text:
Independent boundary reviewer accepted 5cc2572: historical inspection loads one generation without copying current state; callers receive isolated mutable copies, and pre-write validation remains intact.
The authored before recording fails; the unchanged regression input passes after, alongside 15/15 storage/read tests and TypeScript validation. Live instance → component type → property data type navigation also remains correct. Complete checkpoint acceptance is recorded separately.
